boundary_evidence: One contiguous run of the Nitro SDK's gx.c, 0x02053a90..0x02053d9c: 8 functions, gapless in config/arm9/delinks.txt. Every member drives the display-control registers (POWCNT 0x04000304, DISPSTAT 0x04000004, DISPCNT 0x04000000/0x04001000, MASTER_BRIGHT 0x0400006c/0x0400106c) or the file's own display state (data_02099fcc, data_020a6084).

mwccarm emits .text in reverse source order, and the run reads as gx.c top-down from the highest address: GX_Init (func_02053c40), GX_HBlankIntr (func_02053c10, DISPSTAT bit 4), GX_VBlankIntr (func_02053be0, DISPSTAT bit 3), GX_DispOff (func_02053b98), GX_DispOn, GX_SetGraphicsMode, GXS_SetGraphicsMode, GXx_SetMasterBrightness_ (func_02053a90).

The display-off/on members share one piece of state: GX_DispOff clears data_02099fcc and parks DISPCNT's mode bits in data_020a6084, GX_DispOn sets the flag and restores the mode, and GX_SetGraphicsMode records the mode in data_020a6084 and gates it on data_02099fcc. GX_Init reads the GX DMA channel data_02099fd0, which sits in .data beside data_02099fcc.

TOP EDGE: GX_InitGXState (0x02053d9c..0x02053e1c, src/GX_InitGXState.c), which GX_Init calls: it clears the VRAM state block data_020a6088 and VRAMCNT A-I, and lives with that block in gx_state.c, the file between this one and arm9/GX_VramCnt (gx_vramcnt.c, 0x02053e1c..0x02054d38).

BOTTOM EDGE: func_02053a8c (0x02053a8c..0x02053a90) is a 4-byte empty function. Its one caller, the boot routine func_0201a054, calls it immediately before GX_Init (func_02053c40), the SDK's FX_Init(); GX_Init() sequence: it is FX_Init from fx.c, the fixed-point library. Below it, func_020538b8 is FX_Atan2Idx (fx_atan.c; FX_Div into the atan table data_02086214). Neither is gx.c.
No promoted manifest claims any part of 0x02053a90..0x02053d9c.
notes: Hand-assembled, not generated by `tubuild.py create`: tu_map cannot segment arm9/main, so there was no candidate id to create from. The schema follows arm9/GX_BgCnt and arm9/GX_VramCnt.
Named GX_Init after the file's lead function because src/engine/gx/GX.cpp is already the arm9/GX TU (the SDK's upload family, LoadBGPltt..BeginLoadTex).

GX_DispOn, GX_SetGraphicsMode and GXS_SetGraphicsMode carry their SDK names with C linkage (pret pokediamond arm9/lib/NitroSDK/src/GX.c, in its source order reversed), declared in include/nitro/gx/gx.h. The five address-named members stay under extern "C" with their current names; naming them is a separate change across their callers.

Text only. gx.c's variables (data_02099fcc, the display-on flag in .data; data_02099fd0, the GX DMA channel in .data; data_020a6084, the parked display mode in .bss) stay ROM-sourced, as in the other promoted GX TUs; claiming them would need production_mode intact-object.
The file is written ROM-descending because mwccarm emits .text in reverse source order; the emitted object carries the eight functions ascending 0x02053a90..0x02053d9c.
